name: 厚底显腿长透气网纱小白鞋款

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF packshots, light mist-grey #F4F4F4 studio panels and soft warm-white #FAF7F2 infographic screens; vivid color-block backdrops (lemon yellow #F2C838 / indigo blue #4A5FC8 / blush pink #E8A3BC) reserved for lifestyle scenes only; deep charcoal #1F1F1F reserved for the closing shot
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio light, front-left key with soft fill, soft contact shadows, clean controlled highlights, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte white acrylic display blocks, smooth light-grey studio floor, seamless paper sweep, warm-white flat-lay surface
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines; thin-weight numbered badges on charcoal info blocks
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons in charcoal circles, small numbered badges, minimal dotted leader lines for annotations
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for packshots, pairs presented toes-left, consistent scale across the set, chunky platform sole always clearly visible
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean minimal womens-sneaker ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, mist grey #F4F4F4, charcoal text #1F1F1F and one rose-pink accent #E8467C, with lemon yellow #F2C838 / indigo blue #4A5FC8 / blush pink #E8A3BC color blocks reserved for lifestyle scenes only and deep charcoal #1F1F1F reserved for the closing shot; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key, soft fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent charcoal info blocks with thin-weight numbered badges; consistent thin-line icons in charcoal circles; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero angle, consistent product scale, chunky platform sole always clearly visible, balanced composition margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索首图一眼点击，白底合规突出厚底鞋型轮廓
shots.camera: slight 3/4 front view, eye-level, full pair visible with toes pointing left
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front-left key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A pair at a slight 3/4 front view, photographed at eye-level, full pair visible with toes pointing left, filling 60-70% of the frame with an even breathing margin on all sides. Bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the shoes. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. 8K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no brand marks, no extra text, no decorative elements, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒传达厚底显腿长这一核心利益点，承接首图
shots.camera: slight 3/4 view from a subtle low camera angle to emphasize the platform, product in the lower half
shots.lighting: bright soft studio light, front-left key, gentle contact shadow
shots.background: warm-white textured panel #FAF7F2 with thin rectangular frame outline in the accent color
shots.textZone: top-center headline zone inside the frame outline; two short sub-labels below the headline
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Top 40% is the headline zone framed by a thin rectangular outline in {accent_color} on warm-white #FAF7F2, with headline 「{callout_1}」 in #1F1F1F at 36pt and two short sub-labels 「{selling_point_1}」「{selling_point_2}」 at 16pt. Bottom 60%: the pair at a slight 3/4 view from a subtle low camera angle to emphasize the chunky platform, filling 50-60% of the frame overall, bright soft studio lighting with soft contact shadow on the seamless surface. Clean layout with short readable headlines, no dense body text. Negative: no model faces, no watermark, no fake logo, no brand marks, no extra text, no gradient background, no garbled characters, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 侧颜直视厚底高度并给出关键参数，消除“会不会太夸张”疑虑
shots.camera: clean 90-degree side profile, close-up mid shot, single shoe
shots.lighting: bright even studio light, soft contact shadow, no harsh speculars
shots.textZone: a vertical dimension line at the heel plus a right-aligned spec list of short label rows
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce spec screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A single shoe photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile, close-up mid shot on seamless white #FFFFFF, filling 65-75% of the frame with the full chunky platform sole clearly visible. Bright even studio lighting with a soft contact shadow. A thin vertical dimension line in #1F1F1F measures the sole height at the heel, labeled 「{callout_1}」; a right-aligned spec list with three short label rows 「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」 at 14pt, precise values composited in post. Negative: no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no brand marks, no garbled characters, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 给出量脚方法与尺码对照结构，消除“买多大码”犹豫

shots.props: a simple foot-measuring diagram with dotted position marks

Negative: no garbled numbers, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no decorative icons, no photographs of feet, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 放大久走脚酸这一真实痛点，再用缓震厚底给出解法

shots.lighting: left panel slightly underexposed and muted, right panel brighter neutral studio light
shots.background: left muted grey-beige #D8D2C8; right clean white #FFFFFF
shots.props: simple foot-pressure diagram with evenly spread dots on the right panel
shots.textZone: one short pain label on the left panel, one short solution label on the right panel
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Left panel: documentary eye-level view of tired aching feet after a long day of walking, muted heavy grey-beige tone #D8D2C8, slightly underexposed, short label 「{callout_1}」 in #1F1F1F. Right panel: the same feet stepping comfortably into {product}, brighter neutral studio light, the product filling 40-50% of the right panel, a simple foot-pressure diagram with evenly spread dots above, short label 「{callout_2}」. Identical framing and light direction on both sides, only the state differs. shots.lighting: bright soft studio light, front-left key, soft contact shadow

shots.intent: 用选料到成型的三步工序背书做工，建立品质信任

shots.lighting: even soft lighting; black-and-white stills with natural contrast
shots.props: rolled leather material swatches, an industrial sewing machine, a craftsman hand finishing a shoe edge
shots.whitespace: about 15% margins between and around the panels
shots.textZone: one short step title per panel with a one-line description composited in post

Three equal horizontal panels numbered with thin-weight charcoal #1F1F1F badges 01 02 03, the grid filling 60-70% of the frame with about 15% margins between and around the panels: panel one a black-and-white still of rolled leather material swatches; panel two a black-and-white close-up of an industrial sewing machine stitching leather; panel three a black-and-white close-up of a craftsman hand burnishing a shoe edge, no face visible. Negative: no faces, no brand marks, no watermark, no garbled characters, no dense body text, no color casts in the stills, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 源为单张 790px 宽详情页长图，按 15 片 790×1200 切片逐片分析。品类判定依据：规格表标注 EU 34-40 女码、试穿记录均为成年女性（身高 160-178cm）、模特均为成年女性、鞋跟标注 4cm，故 L2=女鞋 而非童鞋，与库内两份童鞋模版（运动鞋/雨靴）区分。页头文案自称“乐福鞋”，但实物为系带厚底松糕底休闲运动鞋（小白鞋），leaf 以实物为准。已剥离：品牌名（含中文与英文店标）、货号、产地、鞋舌上的英文品牌压印（含奢侈品牌字样，模版中严禁复现任何品牌标）、模特人脸与试穿人昵称/头像、全部原文案。尺码数值、合格证/三包卡内容、评分以 {callout}/{selling_point} 短句槽位表达，具体数值由商家回填，不虚构任何不可验证事实。
